verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents its own official Command-Line Interface. It can automate installation, configuration, licensing, password setup, starting connections and silent removal, and is intended for scripting and integration with other systems, which covers the story's core of using an official CLI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, evidence of agent-oriented features such as structured or machine-readable output, and documented CLI coverage beyond deployment and connection tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
You can start a session using CLI parameters. This is useful for automation or if you're integrating AnyDesk with other systems.
For automated or script-based removal without user interaction, use the --remove parameter.
Integrating AnyDesk into your existing IT management tools
